summary: Iter 138 – Role × Permission Matrix fix VERIFIED end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass (GET /api/admin/role-register returns 20 catalog-driven roles incl. custom 'pro_coor' + 83 resources; PUT applies overrides instantly – sales_executive gets 403 on /api/projects when denied, 200 when granted; super_admin auto-re-added to every override; unknown role/resource → 400; role-catalog list matches register). Frontend: /app/admin/role-register renders 'Role × Permission Matrix' with 11 department accordions (dashboard, sales, ops, hr, store, procurement, accounts, finance, safety, logistics, admin) matching sidebar; expanding HR shows 40 menu rows; column headers list all 19 non-super_admin roles including pro_coor + wildcard column; 'Other API Resources' section present; 'By Resource' view lists all 83 resources; toggling employees.read for sales_executive and clicking rr-save produced toast 'Saved — permissions live everywhere · 3 resource(s) overridden' and override persisted after page reload. Role Catalog page shows all 20 roles with user counts. User Management → Create modal role dropdown lists all 20 roles from catalog (super_admin…pro_coor). Baseline overrides (safety_reports, ppe_issuance) restored via PUT at end of tests. Super admin retained full /api/projects access even when its role was the only key in the override.
critical_code_review_comments: RoleRegister.jsx `slug()` uses `department + label` – if two menus in the same dept ever share a label the generated data-testid will collide. Low risk today.

PERMISSIONS_BASE.projects.write contains an unknown role token 'manager_o_p' (not in role catalog, not in ROLES). It survives validation only because PERMISSIONS_BASE is not cleaned on load. Consider a startup validator that logs unknown role tokens in code defaults.
GET /api/admin/role-register calls _resolved() twice (once for `resources`, once for `effective`) – minor optimization only.
reset endpoint uses require_permission('role_register','delete') which is fine but is unusual – 'reset' is a POST that many admins expect to be gated by write. Not a bug, just a note.
seed_data_creation: None – no test users created. Temporary 'projects' override was added during tests and REMOVED at teardown; baseline (safety_reports, ppe_issuance) preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline rbac_overrides in preview DB has exactly 2 keys: safety_reports & ppe_issuance. Custom role 'pro_coor' exists in role_catalog. Pytest regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_role_register.py is idempotent (auto-restores overrides on teardown) and can be re-run any time. If PERMISSIONS_BASE's stray 'manager_o_p' role is ever cleaned up, update the test expectations accordingly.
